feeds.title: Movies Silently
feeds.description: I'm Fritzi! I celebrate all things silent & 1910s-1920s. Trying my best to be amusing.

feeds.title: Silent-ology
feeds.description: This site is lovingly devoted to exploring the incomparable world of silent films. It's an obsessive dig through early film history, seeking details, asking questions, and hopefully offering fresh perspectives on topics ranging from the art of German Expressionism to those darn banana peels.

feeds.title: Silent London Blog
feeds.description: Silent London is a silent cinema blog based in... you can guess where. It began life as a listings site for silent film screenings in London. That is no longer the case.

feeds.title: Louise Brooks Society
feeds.description: Louise Brooks Society - all about the silent film & Jazz Age icon who played Lulu in Pandora's Box. The Louise Brooks Society is the largest & most comprehensive website devoted to any silent movie star. The LBS is an online archive - a place on the information superhighway where individuals can learn about the life and times of the actress.

feeds.title: Always in Dim Light
feeds.description: This blog gives a brief description of italian films. In this blog, you will get to see silent cinema from Italy.

feeds.title: Early & Silent Film
feeds.description: This Blog is a sort of appendix to Early and Silent Cinema (An Introduction for Teachers, Auteur Publishing 2007). It will offer material and discussion on areas not included in the original book, plus updates on interesting resources, video releases and upcoming events.

feeds.title: Ben Model Blog
feeds.description: Ben Model is one of the classic film world's leading silent film accompanists, and is dedicated to bringing silent movies to new audiences.

feeds.title: Jeff Rapsis / Silent Film Music
feeds.description: Chronicling the ongoing adventure of staging silent film screenings with live music in theaters in New England, USA and elsewhere.

feeds.title: Flat Out Pride
feeds.description: Weekly LGBTQIA+ media from Hamilton NZ, made with support of NZ on Air and PROUDly part of CAMA Community Access Media Alliance - Fighting for your right to be on the radio and in the media since 1981

feeds.title: Garbo Seastrom
feeds.description: Covers articles about Silent Film, American and Swedish, Greta Garbo and Victor Sjostrom.

feeds.title: Bayflicks
feeds.description: Lincoln Spector's guide to everything cinema in the San Francisco Bay Area.

feeds.title: Sounds Of Silents
feeds.description: Classic silent movies revitalized with synced symphonic music, image enhancement, watch online or download for free.

feeds.title: Silent San Francisco
feeds.description: The San Francisco Silent Film Festival is a nonprofit organization dedicated to educating the public about silent film as an art form and as a culturally valuable historical record.

feeds.title: Cinema History Blog
feeds.description: The Cinema History Blog looks looks into the facts and people who contributed to the industry. From the pioneers of the Silent Era, to the glamour of classic films.

feeds.title: William Friese-Greene & Me
feeds.description: This site publishes research which casts new light on the life and inventions of the man once called the 'Father of Kinematography'.

feeds.title: Edna's Place
feeds.description: Latest updates on Edna Purviance's sites, related Charlie Chaplin news and items of interest, with a sampling of my other interests.

feeds.title: Silents, Please!
feeds.description: A love letter, and a chronicle. Silents, Please! focuses on silent cinema and silent film history, illustrated plentifully with film stills and animated gifs.

feeds.title: The Screen Hire Company Blog
feeds.description: The Silent Disco Company aim to be the leading supplier of LED Silent Disco Hire across the UK & Europe. Offering good value and exceptional customer service.

feeds.title: The Silent Film Music Podcast with Ben Model Blog
feeds.description: A podcast by silent film accompanist Ben Model, news and reflections on silent movie shows.
